title: Canary Action Surface Narrowing
claim: FP-MCP-314 narrowed the default MCP bridge canary action surface so adjacent manual guarded canary tools are hidden unless FORGEPILOT_CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED=0. The enforced executor remains registered by default. Bridge commit 0c2d3cb contains the implementation.
summary: The MCP bridge repository feature/oauth-auth0 advanced to 0c2d3cb with commit 'Narrow guarded canary action surface'. The change adds CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED defaulting to true and wraps adjacent guarded canary manual tool registrations behind if (!CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED). The enforced executor tool forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate remains registered outside the narrow-surface guard. TypeScript compilation passed after the change.
caveats: The MCP service must be restarted or actions refreshed before the narrowed surface appears in chat.
The narrowed action surface is controlled by FORGEPILOT_CANARY_ACTION_SURFACE_NARROWED and defaults to narrowed unless set to 0.
This packet does not run the canary.
This packet does not create a new approval, clearance, or enablement.
